name: Dominus et Servi
source:
We follow a secret society, Dominus et Servi.
These people want the new laws to pass and have agreed to run,
the test facilities in Nevada and Louisiana for the government.
It is in Nevada that our story begins, where it ends is up to you.
You will be enjoying this game from Logan’s as well as several women's points of view.
translation:
我们追随一个秘密社团“Dominus et Servi”。
这些人希望新法律获得通过并同意参选，
内华达州和路易斯安那州的政府测试设施。
我们的故事在内华达州开始，故事的结局取决于你。
你将从洛根以及几位女性的角度来享受这款游戏。
